name: computer-use
description: Sees and works the apps of this computer in the background through the accessibility interface, without taking the mouse or keyboard: window pictures, controls, menus, typing, scrolling and the clipboard, with an on-screen cursor and Esc to stop. 通过辅助功能接口在后台查看和操作这台电脑上的应用，不占用鼠标和键盘：窗口截图、界面元素、菜单、输入、滚动和剪贴板，操作时屏幕上显示光标，按 Esc 即可停止。
